title: 长对话的信息对应
goal: 辨认对话的问题与方案，并将意见和决定对应到说话人。

points.label: 识别对话中问题与方案的位置
将信息对应到正确的说话人

sources.title: 全国大学英语四、六级考试大纲（2016年修订版）

body.p: 对话的信息一般分为话题、问题、方案和决定。顺序不一定固定，方案也可能不止一个。
听的时候，把每个人的经历、意见和决定分开记。提议是否被采用，要听对方怎么回应。

body.box:
Lena: The display is too large for the hall.
Omar: Could we move it to the studio?
Lena: Yes, I'll reserve the studio.

body.p: 场地太小是 Lena 提出的问题。换到工作室是 Omar 的提议。Lena 接受了，并决定去预约。

steps.d: 开头常引入双方讨论的事项。We need a room for the display 表明话题是展览场地。
问题是眼下的困难，方案是可能的办法。The hall is too small 是问题，try the studio 是方案。
每个行动和意见都对应到说出它的人。Omar 建议使用工作室，Lena 决定预约。
听对方的回应，看方案是否被接受。Lena 说 I'll reserve the studio，说明工作室方案已被采用。

cards.title: 对话结构
rows: We need a room for the display.
cards.note: 回应和决定可能在同一轮里。方案提出后，要听完回应才能确定安排。

cards.title: 信息归属
rows: I borrowed the panels last year.
I think the panels are too heavy.
cards.note: 人称随说话人改变。I 指当前发言者，you 指当前发言的对象。

body.box:
Maya: We need a place to store the costumes until Friday. The office is full of boxes, and the hall will be painted tomorrow.
Chen: The art room has an empty cupboard. We could ask to use it.
Maya: That sounds suitable. I'll speak to the art teacher this afternoon.
Chen: I'll bring the costumes once the cupboard is ready.

What does Maya agree to do?
1. Move the office boxes to the hall
2. Ask the art teacher about storage
3. Bring the costumes to the art room
4. Paint the hall before Friday

body.p: 依据是 I'll speak to the art teacher，Maya 要去找美术老师，第二项把 speak to 改写为 ask。第三项搬服装的是 Chen。

cards.title: 干扰项
rows: We could use the hall. / It's being painted.
The office is full. / Use the cupboard.
The hall will be painted tomorrow.

lines.text: The posters won't fit on the narrow board.
We could put them on the wall, but first we need permission.

options: The posters are too wide for the board.
The wall has no space for the posters.
The board needs permission for its use.
The posters are already on the wall.
items.why: won't fit on the narrow board 说明海报放不进窄展板，第一项对应这一问题。

lines.text: I checked the delivery list this morning, Nina.
Thanks, Sam. I'll contact the driver this afternoon.

options: Check the delivery list this afternoon.
Speak to the driver later today.
Ask Sam to contact the driver.
Complete the list with the driver.
items.why: Nina 说 I'll contact the driver this afternoon，第二项对应她的行动。

lines.text: Could we meet in the cafe?
It's closed on Mondays. The garden is open, though.
All right, let's use the garden.

items.stem: Which place do the speakers finally choose?
options: The cafe before it closes
The cafe on another Monday
The garden instead of the cafe
The garden after the cafe opens
items.why: let's use the garden 是最终决定，第三项对应花园。咖啡馆周一关闭。

lines.text: Ravi, I tried the earlier train yesterday. It was crowded.
Then I'll try the later one today, Mei.

items.stem: Who traveled on the earlier train?
options: Ravi, on a trip today
Ravi, on a trip yesterday
Mei, on a trip today
Mei, on a trip yesterday
items.why: Mei 对 Ravi 说 I tried the earlier train yesterday，第四项对应说话人和时间。

lines.text: The workshop needs a larger table for the clay, but the folding table is in use.
We could borrow the table from the music room. I used it for a meeting last month.
The music class needs it tomorrow. Could we join two small tables instead?
Yes. I'll bring the small tables over this evening.
Thanks. I'll cover them before the workshop begins.

items.stem: What solution do the speakers accept?
options: Borrow the folding table from the workshop.
Use the music room table for the clay.
Place two smaller tables together.
Move the music class to another room.
items.why: 依据是 join two small tables 得到了 Yes 的回应，接受的方案是把两张小桌拼起来，即第三项。

items.stem: What does the first speaker agree to do?
options: Bring the small tables over tonight.
Put covers on the selected tables.
Return the music room table tomorrow.
Use the folding table for a meeting.
items.why: 第一位说话人说 I'll cover them，即给桌子盖上罩布，第二项。第一项搬小桌的是另一位说话人。

lines.text: Hi, Alex. We need to decide where to prepare the community garden's seed packets. The volunteers are coming on Saturday, and I hoped to use the room beside the garden. Have you seen it this week?
I have. The roof is being repaired, so the room is closed until next Tuesday. The tools are still inside, but the packets don't need any of those. Could we work in the school kitchen instead?
The kitchen would be convenient, but it is reserved for a cooking class on Saturday. I asked about it yesterday. The class finishes late, and I don't want volunteers waiting outside.
Then the library meeting room might work. It has enough tables, and we can take the seeds there in boxes. I helped with a book sale in that room last month.
That's a useful suggestion. I'll call the library today and reserve the meeting room. If we start at ten, we should finish before lunch and return the empty boxes to the garden.
Fine. I'll tell the volunteers about the new location after you confirm the booking. They already know the date, so the message only needs the address and starting time.
I'll send you the address as soon as the librarian confirms it. Could you also remind everyone to bring a pen for labeling the packets?
Of course. I'll put that in the same message. We can leave the garden tools where they are until the roof work is finished.

items.stem: Why is the room beside the garden unavailable?
options: A cooking class has reserved the room.
It is closed while its roof is repaired.
A book sale is being held in it.
The garden tools take up all its space.
items.why: 依据是 The roof is being repaired, so the room is closed，即第二项。第一项被烹饪课预订的是学校厨房。

items.stem: Which place do the speakers plan to use?
options: The room beside the community garden
The school kitchen after the class
The library room used for meetings
The garden room after the roof repair
items.why: 第一位说话人说 I'll call the library today and reserve the meeting room，第三项是采用的方案。

items.stem: What does Alex offer to do after the booking is confirmed?
options: Inform the volunteers of the location
Reserve the library meeting room
Send the address to the librarian
Move the tools out of the garden room
items.why: Alex 说 I'll tell the volunteers about the new location，即第一项。第二项预订会议室的是另一位说话人。

lines.text: Hello, Priya. I'm organizing the neighborhood film evening, and we need a screen. I thought we could borrow the large one from the youth center, but I haven't asked them yet.
I spoke to the center yesterday, Leo. Their large screen is being used for a class that evening. They offered a smaller one, and I wrote down its dimensions so we could check them.
The smaller screen might be difficult to see from the back of the hall. Last year we moved the chairs closer, but some people then had trouble reaching the doors.
We could hold two shorter showings with fewer chairs at each one. The screen would be visible without blocking the doors, although we'd need someone to welcome both groups.
That would mean keeping the hall open much later. What about using the plain wall at the front? I tested the projector on it during our meeting, and the picture was clear.
Using the wall sounds better. I'll return the dimensions to the center and explain that we won't need their screen. Could you check that the projector is still available?
Yes, I'll confirm the projector booking this afternoon. Then I'll let the neighbors know that the film starts at seven, as we originally planned.
Good. I'll arrange the chairs so the doors remain clear. We can set them out together before the neighbors arrive, and the welcoming table can stay near the entrance as it did last year.

items.stem: What does Priya propose before Leo mentions the wall?
options: Borrowing the center's large screen
Moving the chairs closer to the screen
Testing the projector at a meeting
Running two showings with fewer chairs
items.why: Priya 说 We could hold two shorter showings with fewer chairs，第四项是她提出的方案。第一项借大屏幕是 Leo 最初的想法。

items.stem: What will Leo check that afternoon?
options: Whether the hall can stay open later
Whether the projector is still free
Whether the center has a smaller screen
Whether the film can start at seven
items.why: Leo 说 I'll confirm the projector booking this afternoon，要核实的是投影仪，即第二项。

items.stem: What is the final solution for showing the film?
options: Show the film on the front wall.
Borrow the center's larger screen.
Move the chairs to the back wall.
Present the film in two showings.
items.why: 依据是 Priya 的 Using the wall sounds better，之后双方安排投影仪和座位，即第一项。
